summary_1line: Vyasa teaches that true Brahmanhood and liberation arise from renouncing desire, practicing compassion, mastering senses, and realizing the Self beyond the elements.

image_candidates.scene_text: A serene yogin sits unmoving in meditation as streams of desire symbolized by rivers flow into him like an ocean without disturbing his calm.
The moon emerges bright from dark clouds, symbolizing a sage freed from desire and stains of the world.
A contemplative teacher gestures while describing the five elements—space, wind, fire, water, and earth—surrounding the human body.
